quality_proposal.A: No speed bridges, interior residuals <=50 ms, distance scale deviation <=3%; native support still does not prove cause.
quality_proposal.B: Bridged laps within the rounded-up 2022-2025 P90 bound ceiling, interior residuals <=150 ms and scale deviation <=3%.
quality_proposal.C: Any larger model bound, interior residual >150 ms, or scale deviation >3%; annotate, do not block Tier 1.
quality_proposal.qualification: Distance-bound thresholds are descriptive of this archive, not calibrated accuracy or probabilities. Equal endpoint speeds can hide dynamics; bridge flags always remain. Current runtime only applies the already authorized interior-residual C annotation; others stay ungraded.
